title: Fix bitmapPixels always undefined — DefineBitsLossless2 dead code in publish path
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx line ~4556, usePublish is called with bitmapPixels: undefined hardcoded. The encodeDefineBitsLossless2 call in compile.ts (lines ~420-430 and ~1186-1196) is gated on options?.bitmapPixels?.get(...) so it is completely dead code. PNG bitmaps in the library never encode as DefineBitsLossless2 (tag 36) in published SWFs. Fix: implement bitmapPixels collection in Shell.tsx — iterate the library's bitmap items, read their pixel data (canvas or offscreen rendering), and pass the resulting Map<string, ImageData> to usePublish. This enables transparent PNG bitmaps to be correctly encoded with alpha channel preserved.
